edits.old: Every call is one hop to the owning service on its own base (DP-11, DP-13) with the 2 s client budget; the suite calls no service through another service. The 60 second model budget is not a REST budget: it belongs to AgentRunWorkflow of section 12.5.
edits.new:
Every call is one hop to the owning service on its own base (DP-11, DP-13) with the 2 s client budget; the suite calls no service through another service. The 60 second model budget is not a REST budget: it belongs to AgentRunWorkflow of section 12.5.

Contract version: the suite builds against the OpenAPI and AsyncAPI documents of API Specification v5, document version 5.0.0, for rwb-agent, rwb-case, rwb-document, rwb-source-data and rwb-access, on the /v1 base paths.

The admin reads are reached through the gateway-bff route as a pass-through of one hop; the route name is agreed with the route contract. The rwb-agent service login is named the rwb-agent login (DP-02) until its string is agreed with the ACE database team. The stale-input criterion AC5 of the legacy story RWB-E1-059 and its TC-E1-059-05 belong to RWB-ITG-E1059-ITG and are not run by this suite.

edits.old: A consumer dedupes on the event ID through its inbox (ADR-015, DP-09). The payload of each event is the owner's published schema; the suite asserts the envelope and the fields above and never the whole body of a prompt or an answer.
edits.new:
A consumer dedupes on the event ID through its inbox (ADR-015, DP-09). The payload of each event is the owner's published schema; the suite asserts the envelope and the fields above and never the whole body of a prompt or an answer.

Contract baseline of the agent platform: `rwb.agent.AgentRunCompleted.v1` (EV-28) is the only member of the `rwb.agent.<Event>.v1` family that the sources name, and any further member is a new version of the topic's contract, agreed with its consumers. No evaluation-completed event is declared: the completion of an evaluation is a row state, which the suite polls to status "DONE". The element names of the evaluation report and of the metrics are fixed by the contract; their member types, the nested members of `promotion_conditions` and `watch_measures` and the type of the inputs reference of the decision record are agreed at the contract review with their owners, and the contract and the stubs are then updated with no change of behaviour. The legacy sample key is kept. `agent_run_daily` is outside this baseline and belongs to the monitor story that names it.

edits.old: - The 2 s client budget, the evaluation poll interval and the 60 s workflow budget.
edits.new:
- The 2 s client budget, the evaluation poll interval and the 60 s workflow budget.
- Environment values of the agent platform are reviewed values per environment, never template constants or values in the suite code: the INT-23 host, port, certificate and certificate authority, the Key Vault entry names, the login, the topic partition, replication and retention values, the worker concurrency, the budget measurement points and the alarm thresholds. The infrastructure behind them is the private path to INT-23 with TLS and mTLS, the `rwb_agent` login with grants on that schema only, and the topic with its retry and `.dlt` topics and the producer ACL.
- Deployment values of rwb-agent are also reviewed values per environment: replica counts, resource requests and limits, probe paths and timings, start-up and rollout windows and alert thresholds. Later migrations take the next numbers of the service's own Flyway sequence, flags are read from the platform library and no chart holds a flag value, and the admin operations are released on a second colour behind the gateway-bff route, with traffic moved only after the synthetic load, approve and listing check passes.
